{07 14 00}Thanks to you, {04 1f 00},{01 00 00 05 00}
I've been able to enjoy
all of my favorite fossils!
{07 19 00}But now it's time to walk
away from the fossil game
while I'm still on top.
{07 00 00}{07 1a 00}You are a true master of
fossils! All of {04 03 00} 
is proud, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}Thank you so much for all
your help!{01 00 00 05 00} You're a true
friend!

{07 00 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}, thank you for
supporting my fossil
collecting!
{07 14 00}But now it's time to hang
up fossil hunting and walk
off into the sunset.
{07 00 00}Yep! {01 00 00 05 00}No more fossils for
me! I'm going back to my
normal life, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 1a 00}You're {04 03 00}'s last
hope for paleontology!{01 01 00}
Good luck, fellow scientist!
